tools.name: send-image
tools.description: DEPRECATED - prefer the universal send-file tool (works for images and every other file type). Send an image to the user; displayed inline in the chat. Supports public URLs or local file paths.

url.description: Public URL of the image, objectId (obj_...) or objects URL (.../objects/obj_...) (use this OR filePath)

filePath.description: File path in /workspace/ (e.g., '/workspace/image.png'). This is the shared volume accessible to all MCAs. Use this OR url.

tools.name: send-audio
tools.description: DEPRECATED - prefer the universal send-file tool (works for audio and every other file type). Send an audio file to the user; playable in the chat. Supports public URLs or local file paths.

url.description: Public URL of the audio, objectId (obj_...) or objects URL (.../objects/obj_...) (use this OR filePath)

filePath.description: File path in /workspace/ (e.g., '/workspace/audio.mp3'). This is the shared volume accessible to all MCAs. Use this OR url.

tools.name: send-video
tools.description: DEPRECATED - prefer the universal send-file tool (works for video and every other file type). Send a video to the user; playable in the chat. Supports public URLs or local file paths.

url.description: Public URL of the video, objectId (obj_...) or objects URL (.../objects/obj_...) (use this OR filePath)

filePath.description: File path in /workspace/ (e.g., '/workspace/video.mp4'). This is the shared volume accessible to all MCAs. Use this OR url.

thumbnailUrl.description: Optional URL for video thumbnail/preview image

tools.name: send-file
tools.description: Send ANY file to the user — markdown, images, PDF, audio, video, CSV, JSON, text or any other type. The chat renders each type appropriately (markdown formatted, images inline, PDF readable inline, players for audio/video, tables for CSV, syntax highlight for JSON) and the user always gets the same 4 actions: download, open in FileViewer, fullscreen and share. Prefer this tool over send-image/send-audio/send-video/send-html-file. Supports public URLs or file paths on the shared /workspace volume.

url.description: Public URL of the file, objectId (obj_...) or objects URL (.../objects/obj_...) (use this OR filePath)

filePath.description: File path in /workspace/ (e.g., '/workspace/report.md'). This is the shared volume accessible to all MCAs. Use this OR url. Volume files are sent as live references: the FileViewer auto-refreshes when the file changes.

filename.description: Display name for the file (e.g., 'report.pdf'). Required if using url, optional for filePath.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type (e.g., 'application/pdf') — inferred from the extension when omitted

size.description: Optional file size in bytes — read from the file when omitted

tools.name: send-html
tools.description: Send an HTML widget to the user. The HTML will be rendered directly in the chat. Use this to display UI mockups, interactive previews, styled tables, diagrams, or any visual content that can be represented with HTML/CSS. The HTML is sandboxed for security.

html.description: HTML content to render. Can include inline <style> tags for CSS.

height.description: Optional fixed height in pixels. If not provided, height will be auto-calculated.

tools.name: send-html-file
tools.description: DEPRECATED — prefer the universal send-file tool (same live FileViewer auto-refresh for HTML and every other file type). Send an HTML file to the user; the file will be rendered inline in the chat and can be opened in a dedicated FileViewer window that auto-refreshes when the file changes.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the HTML file (e.g., '/workspace/mockup.html'). The file must exist on the shared volume.

tools.name: notify-by-email
tools.description: Send a notification email to the current user. The email is sent via Resend from a Teros notification address (notifications@teros.ai). Use this instead of Gmail when you want to deliver a report or alert to the user by email — it does not require any email account connection. The user's email is resolved automatically from their Teros account. The backend appends a Teros banner with a CTA to os.teros.ai at the bottom automatically — do NOT include your own footer or Teros branding. content.description:
Email body content as email-safe HTML. The backend sends it as-is (no wrapping template) and appends a Teros banner at the bottom. See the tool description for HTML formatting guidelines. If contentType is "text", line breaks are converted to
tags.

contentType.description: Format of the content. "text" = plain text (will be converted to HTML with line breaks). "html" = raw HTML (will be embedded as-is). Default: "html".

tools.name: share-file
tools.description: Create a PUBLIC share link for a file on the workspace volume. ⚠️ The URL is PUBLIC: ANYONE who has it can view the file content (markdown rendered as a page, HTML as-is, other types served directly) until the share is revoked with unshare-file. Returns { shareId, url } — send the url to the user or via whatsapp send-text / any channel. The FileViewer will show the file as shared. Prefer markdown (.md) or HTML files for readable shared pages.

filePath.description: File path in /workspace/ (e.g., '/workspace/report.md'). Must be on the shared workspace volume.

channelId.description: Channel that provides the workspace context (e.g. ch_xxx). Defaults to the current conversation channel.

tools.name: unshare-file
tools.description: Revoke a PUBLIC share link created with share-file. Pass the shareId returned by share-file, or the filePath (the share is looked up in the current workspace). After revocation the URL returns a 404 page — nobody can access the content anymore. The link is public until revoked, so revoke it as soon as sharing is no longer needed.

shareId.description: Share ID returned by share-file (use this OR filePath).

filePath.description: File path in /workspace/ whose share should be revoked (use this OR shareId). Resolved against the current workspace.

channelId.description: Channel that provides the workspace context (required with filePath when not called from a channel).

tools.name: get-share
tools.description: Check whether a file on the workspace volume currently has a PUBLIC share link. Returns { shared: boolean, shareId?, url? }. Use it to avoid creating a duplicate share, or to find the existing URL before revoking with unshare-file.

channelId.description: Channel that provides the workspace context. Defaults to the current conversation channel.
